source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: During any **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** it makes, this unit may pass across models (except TITANIC models) and terrain features. While doing so it may move within **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of the enemy's models but cannot finish the move inside it, and it passes any **[Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)** automatically.
